QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_31

question.text: The same fund in best-case yielded Net IRR = 12.98% and Gross IRR = 18.13%. The percentage drop from Gross to Net is approximately:

explanation.text: The Logic: Drop = 18.13% − 12.98% = 5.15 pp; as % of Gross IRR = 5.15/18.13 ≈ 28.4%. The Trap: Other figures overstate the impact. Cross-Exam Context: Directly from workbook Example 7 conclusion. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Clients often miss this gap — walk them through 'after fees, what do I actually pocket?'
